;Armed conflict and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**Five people are killed and over 10 injured in an [[Improvised explosive device|IED]] bomb explosion in [[Kabul]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://www.dailytrust.com.ng/bomb-on-govt-bus-kills-5-in-afghanistan.html (Dailytrust)]
*[[2018–19 Sudanese protests]]
**Over 13 people have been killed when [[Sudanese Armed Forces|Sudanese forces]] use live ammunition to break up a protester camp in [[Khartoum]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/06/sudan-military-moves-khartoum-sit-protesters-190603035536012.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**[[Boko Haram]] storms multiple [[Nigerian military|military base]]s in the Nigerian state of [[Borno State|Borno]]. Casualties are unknown. [https://guardian.ng/news/boko-haram-attacks-military-bases-in-borno-steal-arms/ (''The Guardian'' Nigeria)]
*[[2019 Tripoli shooting]]
**A gunman kills four security officers and injures two before blowing himself up in [[Tripoli, Lebanon|Tripoli]], [[Lebanon]].  [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-48511776 (BBC News)]
;Arts and culture
*[[James Holzhauer]] is defeated on the American quiz show ''[[Jeopardy!]]'', concluding a victory streak of 32 games with an earnings total of $2,464,216, but falls short of the winnings record set by [[Ken Jennings]] in 2004. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/arts-entertainment/2019/06/03/james-holzhauer-was-pace-break-jeopardy-record-today-then-this-happened-spoiler/ (''Washington Post'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[List_of_missing_aircraft#2001–present|2019 Indian Air Force An-32 disappearance]]
**An [[Indian Air Force]] [[Antonov An-32]] goes [[List of missing aircraft|missing]] shortly after takeoff from an airbase in [[Assam]]. All 13 people aboard are presumed dead as search operations continue. [https://www.indiatoday.in/india/story/indian-air-force-an-32-missing-assam-1541514-2019-06-03 (''India Today'')]

;Health and environment
*Authorities say that a patient has died amid an outbreak of [[Legionnaires' disease]] in a recently opened hospital in [[Grove City, Ohio]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/hospital-reports-patient-death-amid-legionnaires-outbreak-63448905 (ABC News)] 

;Law and crime
*[[Insider trading]]. The US Supreme Court refused to take an appeal from the [[United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit|US Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit]] decision. The 'denial of cert' leaves standing the conviction of [[Mathew Martomo]] on charges of [[insider trading]]. on information leaked to him from representatives of two major [[pharmaceutical]] companies. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-court-insidertrading/supreme-court-rejects-insider-trading-appeal-brought-by-sacs-martoma-idUSKCN1T41SP (Reuters)]
